propositions: Rotation state must be moved from inline fields in bindings.json to a separate .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file to enable future removal of scattered rotation writes from the large sort-ordered bindings.json

During the A2-1 compatibility phase, new binaries must write rotation stamps to both the sidecar and legacy inline fields, and read the chronologically maximum value to support mixed-version deployments

BindingStore.save() must persist sidecar state through its defined save paths (end-of-pass, dispatch_one.py write-ahead, binding_store.py recovery), while reconcile-check with persist=False must never create the sidecar
The new get_rotation.py module must be extracted as a cohesive boundary to respect the locked 800-line policy on binding_store.py (749 lines) and outbound_differ.py (799 lines)
Git staging and reconciliation must explicitly include get_rotation.json in both the staging list and basename membership checks because local reconciliation does not use git add -A

After interleaved old-binary and new-binary passes, rotation order must match the all-new sequence, demonstrating that max(sidecar, legacy) semantics and dual-write ensure correctness across version transitions
